description: This Java source file defines a REST API resource class `RescheduleLoansApiResource` for handling loan rescheduling operations within the Fineract microfinance platform. It provides endpoints for retrieving reschedule reasons template, reading specific reschedule requests, creating new reschedule requests, updating existing ones (approve/reject), and listing all reschedule requests. It utilizes JAX-RS annotations for REST endpoints, Swagger annotations for API documentation, and various services for processing commands and data serialization.

classes.name: RescheduleLoansApiResource
classes.description: A REST API resource class that manages loan rescheduling operations, including retrieving reschedule reasons, viewing, creating, approving, and rejecting reschedule requests.

methods.name: retrieveTemplate
methods.description: Retrieves a template of all reschedule loan reasons.

methods.name: readLoanRescheduleRequest
methods.description: Retrieves a specific loan reschedule request by schedule id; supports preview functionality.

methods.name: createLoanRescheduleRequest
methods.description: Creates a new loan reschedule request from JSON input.

methods.name: updateLoanRescheduleRequest
methods.description: Updates an existing loan reschedule request; can approve or reject it based on command parameter.

methods.name: retrieveAllRescheduleRequest
methods.description: Retrieves all reschedule requests, optionally filtered by command type or loan id.
